meta.title: Scope Creep Guard
meta.description: Check whether a new client request fits your agreed project scope, and reply with confidence.

auth.heroTitle: Keep client scope private, then check requests with confidence.
auth.heroDescription: Email/password auth keeps every project, scope, and check history tied to the person who created it.
auth.loginDescription: Sign in to your protected Scope Creep Guard workspace.
auth.registerDescription: Start with a private account so every scope check belongs only to you.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Each project holds one agreed scope you check requests against.
projects.emptyDescription: Create your first project and paste in its scope. You'll then be able to check whether new client requests are covered.
projects.newDescription: Save the agreed scope once — then check every future request against it.
projects.scopePlaceholder: Paste the deliverables, revision rounds, and exclusions here…
projects.scopeTip: Tip: paste directly from your contract, proposal, or SOW. Include both what's delivered and what's excluded for the sharpest verdicts.
projects.uploadHint: Accepts .txt, .md, or .pdf up to 5 MB. Text is copied into the field below; the file is not stored.

history.title: History
history.selectProject: Select a project to see its check history.
history.emptyDescription: Once you check a client request for this project, it'll show up here.

check.noProjectDescription: Create a project and save its scope to start checking client requests.
check.noScopeTitle: This project has no saved scope yet.
check.noScopeDescription: Add the deliverables and exclusions from your contract or SOW so requests can be compared against them.
check.requestPlaceholder: Paste the message or request your client just sent…
check.requestRequiredHint: Paste a client request above to run a check.
check.openaiNotice: Checking sends this project's scope and your request text to OpenAI for analysis. Review the result before sending anything to your client.

result.emptyBeforeAction: Paste the client's new request on the left and run
result.emptyAfterAction: You'll get a verdict, the reasoning behind it, and a ready-to-edit reply.
result.loading: Comparing the request against your scope…
result.errorDescription: Something went wrong while checking this request. Your scope and the request text are still saved — just try again.
result.shortScopeTitle: Your scope is too short to judge
result.shortScopeDescription: There isn't enough detail in the saved scope to compare this request reliably. Add the deliverables, revision rounds, and exclusions from your contract, proposal, or SOW, then check again.
result.verifyWarning: This is an AI-assisted assessment, not a legal or final decision. Review it before you reply to your client.

reply.heading: Suggested reply to client
reply.sendYourself: You send it yourself — nothing is sent automatically.
reply.confirmReplace: Switching tone will replace your edits to this reply. Continue?

changeOrder.heading: Change order draft
changeOrder.legalNotice: This document is a draft to help you start the conversation — it is not legal advice. Review and adapt it before sending.

examples.inText: On the Home page, could you fix the typo in the hero headline and adjust the accent color to a slightly darker blue? This would be part of our revision round.
examples.borderlineText: Could you add a small newsletter sign-up section to the bottom of the Home page? It is a new element, but it sits on a page that is already in scope.
examples.outText: Can you also add 3 more pages, prepare mobile versions of all the pages, and do a second round of revisions after we review?

workspace.loadingDescription: Fetching your private projects and history.
workspace.footer: Scope Creep Guard stores projects and history in your authenticated workspace. Scope analysis uses OpenAI. Verdicts are AI-assisted suggestions, not legal advice.

errors.requestBodyInvalid: Request body must be a JSON object.
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.duplicateEmail: A user with this email already exists.
errors.requestFailed: The request failed. Please try again.
errors.authServiceUnavailable: Unable to reach the auth service. Please try again.
errors.workspaceLoadFailed: Unable to load your workspace. Please refresh the page.
errors.analysisUnavailable: Analysis is unavailable. Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and try again.
errors.analysisFailed: Scope analysis failed. Please try again.
errors.analysisInvalid: The model returned an unusable analysis. Please try again.
errors.analysisInputTooLarge: Scope and request together are too large to analyze.
errors.analysisRateLimited: Too many analysis requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.scopeFileEmpty: Could not extract text from this file.
errors.evaluationHistoryNotFound: That scope check was not found.
